# Skip Link

You might say
Keyboard users have to press Tab too many times to reach the main content. Can they jump there directly?

**A link that lets keyboard users skip repeated navigation and move to the main content**·A skip link appears when someone starts tabbing through a page and moves focus past repeated header links to the main content. It is not ordinary navigation, and it needs a visible focus state and a working target.

SkipLinkSkip to content

## You can say this to an AI Agent

> “
> Add a Skip to main content link first in page order, visible on keyboard focus, targeting the single main region. Ensure the target can receive focus, for example with tabindex="-1" when needed. Press Enter from the link and confirm document.activeElement moves into main; it should not occupy layout during normal pointer browsing.

Skip Link**≠**[Anchor](/vibe-hub/anchor?lang=en)

[Skip Link](/vibe-hub/skip-link?lang=en) is a keyboard shortcut available when entering a page. [Anchor](/vibe-hub/anchor?lang=en) is an in-page table of contents that anyone can use.
